page.overview:
What is Kalimdor?

Kalimdor (Titan and Darnassian for land of eternal starlight) is one of the main continents of Azeroth — part of Warcraft. It is located to the west of the Eastern Kingdoms, southwest of Northrend and northwest of Pandaria. The Great Sea lies in between the continents. Kalimdor is home to the night elves, orcs, tauren, trolls, and draenei.

Also known as: Continent of Kalimdor.
